investment_policy_en:
The fund aims to provide income plus capital growth of at least cash (based on one-month Euribor, the rate at which banks borrow money from each other) plus 3.5% a year, before any charges are taken, over any five-year period, while applying ESG Criteria and Sustainability Criteria. At least 70% of the fund is invested in in corporate bonds and government bonds, cash and asset-backed securities from anywhere in the world, including emerging markets. At least 75% of the fund will be denominated in euro or hedged back to euro.

No credit quality restrictions apply to these investments. This is a global flexible bond fund looking to generate return over the economic and credit cycles, using a combination of bottom-up credit selection and active management of interest rate exposure. ESG factors are fully integrated into credit analysis and investment decisions.

The fund’s recommended holding period is five years. In normal market conditions, the fund’s expected average leverage – how much it can increase its investment position by borrowing money or using derivatives – is 450% of the fund’s net asset value.
